title: 第021章 提亲第022章 雕人
lines: 八月江淮，烟雨行舟。
一艘宝船顺流而下，在热闹非凡的码头靠岸。
“弟兄们，到地儿咯！”
陈孤舟跟在人群后，压了压遮阳的斗笠。
巨鲸帮此行声势不小。
最前方一人龙行虎步，气势昂扬，正是巨鲸帮的三当家赵龙。江湖人称‘金枪龙爷’，踏入通脉境界三十年的二流高手。
江湖上一流、二流高手，不是嘴巴说说。而是自己一拳一脚，一场场生死厮杀拼出来的。
你刚入通脉，可能是三流高手，也可能是二流高手。
但总得打过才知道本事！
而未入通脉，皆不入流，在道上连个名号都混不上。
此番同行之人还有三名通脉舵主，皆是江湖上有些名声的三流高手。二十几位煅骨好手，上百名搬血境，负责搬运聘礼。
陈孤舟正在其中。
他不用搬聘礼，却还躲在人群最后，只为降低自己的存在感。谁让江淮有个恨不得将他大卸八块的大仇人呢？
“万一遇到了谢天宇，被追着砍事小，坏了自己的名声，背上背信弃义的名头，今后在巨鲸帮可就不好混了。”
陈孤舟缩了缩脖子。
“哈哈哈，龙爷，多年未见，您这身子骨依旧雄健！”
码头上一行人早已等候，主动迎了上来。
来人是冯氏的当代家主冯树德，其后是冯家大少，未来的家主冯晓峰。一行三十余人，陈孤舟前世基本都认识。
不错。
他加入巨鲸帮要办的第一件大事，正是到江淮向冯氏提亲。
“走走走，咱们府上相谈。”
双方一阵寒暄，乘车前往冯府。
陈孤舟压了压笠檐，快步跟上。
一担担聘礼搬入冯府，场面热闹非凡。
“人生兜兜转转，居然又回来了。”看着模拟第2年的冯府，陈孤舟心中感慨。
翌日。
双方商谈婚约，将吉日定在半年后的三月。这件事其实早有定数，此番不过走个过场罢了。
午后。
赵龙带着一行人匆匆离去。
一位通脉境界的舵主，高老壮等十多名煅骨好手，加上三十几个搬血力士被留了下来。
他们将在半年后护送冯家千金，前往千里之外的岷江府。
“此举似颇有深意。”
作为高老壮的小弟，陈孤舟理所当然也被留了下来。
在冯府的日子很平静。
陈孤舟随遇而安，开始以雕龙右手刀突破通脉。
这一世，他想走走正道。
第一次。
因窍穴蕴养不够，不出预料的失败了。
content_en:
In August, boating along the Yangtze River and Huaihe River in misty rain.
A treasure ship sailed down the river and docked at the bustling dock.
"Brothers, get there!"
Chen Guzhou followed the crowd and pressed down the hat to protect him from the sun.
The Giant Whale Gang made this trip with great momentum.
The person at the front is walking like a dragon and a tiger, and he is high-spirited. It is Zhao Long, the third leader of the Giant Whale Gang. Known as the ‘Golden Spear Dragon Master’ in the world of martial arts, he is a second-rate master who has been in the realm of Tongmai for thirty years.
The first-rate and second-rate masters in the arena are not just words. But he fought it out with his own punches and kicks, and in life-and-death fights.
If you have just entered Tongmai, you may be a third-rate expert or a second-rate expert.
But you have to fight to know your skills!
But if they have not entered the Tongmai, they will not enter the flow, and they will not even be able to get a name on the Tao.
There are also three Tongmai helmsmen accompanying this trip, all of whom are third-rate masters with some reputation in the world. Twenty-odd bone-burning experts and hundreds of blood-moving people were responsible for carrying the betrothal gift.
Chen Guzhou is among them.
He didn't need to carry the bride price, but he still hid at the back of the crowd, just to reduce his sense of existence. Who gave Jiang Huai a big enemy who wanted to tear him into pieces?
"What if I meet Xie Tianyu and I am chased and attacked for a trivial matter, my reputation is ruined, and I am accused of treachery. It will be difficult for me to get along with the Giant Whale Gang from now on."
Chen Guzhou shrank his neck.
"Hahaha, Mr. Long, I haven't seen you for many years, but your bones are still strong!"
A group of people on the pier were already waiting and took the initiative to greet them.
The visitor was Feng Shude, the current head of the Feng family, followed by Feng Xiaofeng, the eldest son of the Feng family and the future head of the family. There were more than thirty people in the group, and Chen Guzhou basically knew them in his previous life.
good.
The first big thing he had to do when he joined the Giant Whale Gang was to go to Jianghuai to propose marriage to Feng.
"Let's go, let's talk at home."
The two parties exchanged pleasantries for a while and then drove to Feng Mansion.
Chen Guzhou pressed the eaves of his hat and followed quickly.
Loads of betrothal gifts were moved into the Feng Mansion, and the scene was very lively.
"Life has gone full circle, but it's back again." Chen Guzhou sighed inwardly as he looked at the Feng Mansion in the second year of simulation.
The next day.
The two parties discussed the marriage contract and set the auspicious date in March half a year later. This matter has actually been decided for a long time, and this time it is just a formality.
Afternoon.
Zhao Long left in a hurry with a group of people.
A helmsman in the realm of Tongmai, Gao Laozhuang and more than a dozen bone-forging experts, plus more than thirty blood-moving warriors, were left behind.
They will escort the daughter of the Feng family to Minjiang Mansion, thousands of miles away, in half a year.
"This move seems to have profound meaning."
As Gao Laozhuang's younger brother, Chen Guzhou was naturally retained.
The days in Feng Mansion were peaceful.
Chen Guzhou took matters into his own hands and began to use the Diaolong right hand knife to break through the Tongmai.
In this life, he wants to take the right path.
first.
Because the acupoints were not nourished enough, it failed as expected.
